new_relations.title: Observer receives a constrained view rather than total access
new_relations.project_anchor: The project uses aperture-dependent perception: observers may name a larger structure from only the fragment or aspect available to them.
new_relations.biblical_structure: Moses asks to see divine glory but receives a limited protected view rather than unrestricted face-to-face access
new_relations.source_direction: Project aperture/observer model first; Exodus comparison later.
new_relations.mismatch: The passage concerns Moses' encounter with God and does not establish the project's observer geometry.
